name: Black Lotus (Nina Barker) (Serpent of the Light, of the Widows)

system.concept: Serpent of the Light who feeds on and destroys the memories of educated men, favored client-service of the Widows

morality.path: Path of Power and the Inner Voice

system.biography:
Background

Nina Barker, daughter of a renowned biblical scholar who neglected her for his work, tried everything from suicide attempts to affairs with older lovers to drugs to gain his attention, without success. Raped and left for dead in an Amsterdam alley, she was Embraced by a Serpent of the Light impressed by her degradation. She hunted down her mortal father, Dominated him into forgetting his faith, and stripped every memory from his mind before presenting the hollow shell of him as a tribute to the Widows of Montreal, whom she joined as "Black Lotus." She takes pleasure in stripping educated men of their memories and everything they've learned, earning the enmity of the scholarly Librarians coven.

Roleplaying Hints

Cunning. Your eyes, though seductive, are those of a predator, coldly searching for your next victim. You especially delight in seducing older men and women.

Secrets

Nina learns much of the Shepherds' business from Raphael Catarari, who visits her regularly, and habitually steals a little of each client's past without their knowledge.
system.notes: Embraced 1983. Apparent age: late teens. @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.paths-of-enlightenment.JournalEntry.nNkKkOwEHChVViI4]{Path of Power and the Inner Voice} 6. Disciplines (as printed): Auspex 3, Dementation 4, Dominate 5, Obfuscate 1, Presence 2, Serpentis 2.

system.description: Rather than requiring eye contact, you may use Dominate through skin-to-skin contact alone (a Physical Challenge may be needed on unwilling subjects). The touch need not be maintained while issuing the command, but only one command may be given per contact; using Dominate again requires touching the subject anew.

Commands you implant via Dominate become extremely resistant to being overridden by other vampires. Any other Dominate user attempting to countermand your instruction on the subject must spend an extra Willpower Trait and bid two extra Traits on the test.
system.duration: As long as the original command stands

system.description: Spend eight Willpower Traits and make a Static Mental Challenge against a 12-Trait difficulty to plunge an entire city (or a 30-mile radius) into temporary mass insanity: mortals riot and rampage, vampires frenzy, and other supernatural beings suffer analogous effects until the next sunrise. Any Cainite caught in the blast radius must make a Self-control/Instincts Virtue Test against a five-Trait difficulty or instantly frenzy; once recovered, she is down three Traits resisting further frenzy triggers that night.

The Malkavian focuses away from an inanimate object so completely that it ceases to exist in her own perception — and, by the strange logic of Dementation, it truly stops affecting her. A locked door she refuses to see becomes an open archway she can step through; a sword she denies will pass through her body without cutting her. This power cannot be used to deny the existence of living creatures, undead, or spirits — only inanimate objects.

MET System: Spend one Blood Trait and one Willpower Trait to deny the existence of one material object for the next hour or scene. A denied weapon cannot hurt you; a denied stake would not paralyze you; denied armor would not stop your fist. You may Deny only one object at a time, and the effect only benefits you personally — you cannot extend it to others, even by touch.

Maintain physical contact with an object or location and concentrate for a turn, expending a Mental Trait, then ask the Narrator one question about who last touched it, whether it was involved in stressful situations, or what strong emotions drove its user. May be used repeatedly for greater insight; objects of powerful emotional resonance may force a derangement upon the user for the scene.

items.name: Serpentis — 1 Basic — The Tongue of the Asp

system.description: At will, your tongue shifts into a serpent's, capable of striking up to a foot and a half away to inflict one aggravated wound and drain blood from a victim on successive turns.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
